name: 财务分析与预测
tagline: 用你的财报核数、算指标、带回测和区间做预测

answers.解决什么: 对一家中国 A 股上市公司，用我上传的财报（三张表与年报）：先核数据（勾稽、对照年报披露），再把问题点到的科目和一组固定的核心指标算出来、看清走势；再对营业收入、归母净利润做预测，每个预测都先回测，再给区间和假设。
answers.不解决什么: 不逐科目预测整套报表；比率不单独外推；数据里没有的不硬算、不冒充，照实说算不出来；只做 A 股上市公司；不评价好坏、不下结论，不给买卖建议、评级、目标价。

workflow.title: 定范围
workflow.summary: 看问题问的是哪家公司、要哪些科目和指标、要不要预测；你的数据里没有这家公司就停下说明
workflow.why: 公司不在你的数据里就不往下做，也不去别处找（你答的第 12 条）
workflow.method_text: Pass the task id given in the step instructions on every tool call. Use only the user's own data through list_my_data, read_my_data and read_my_table: no web, no memory, no other source. A cell address is <dataset_id>:<sheet>!<row label>@<column label>, with the labels copied exactly as read_my_table shows them (a repeated label carries #2). Never type, copy or work out a number yourself: every number you hand back is either a table cell with its address, or the result of compute with its compute id (ids are not consecutive; that is normal). If the scope artifact says in_data is false, do no work in this step: return the structure with empty lists and note 'no data for this company'. Describe, do not judge: no rating, target price, or advice to buy, sell or hold. The steps name line items in standard wording; the user's workbook may word the same item differently (for example 归属于母公司股东的净利润 for 归属于母公司所有者的净利润, 所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 所有者权益合计, 归属于母公司所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 归属于母公司所有者权益合计). Use the row that is the same item and copy its label exactly as read_my_table shows it; a different wording of the same item is not a second basis. Read the question and name the company. Call list_my_data and look at the titles and file names of the user's data: one workbook (an Excel file with the sheets 资产负债表、利润表、现金流量表、主要会计数据) and the annual report PDFs. in_data is true only when the user's data is about this company. If it is not, set in_data false, say in note which company was asked and that the user's data does not cover it, and stop: do not look anywhere else. When in_data is true fill: workbook (its dataset id and the sheet names as read_my_table shows them); reports (one entry per annual report PDF: year and dataset id); items (the line items or indicators the question names, written as in the question); forecast_quarters (how many quarters the question asks to forecast, at most 4; 0 if it asks none); extra_flow_items (flow line items the question names other than revenue and net profit attributable to the parent, to be forecast as well). If the same line item appears under two bases in the workbook (for example consolidated and parent-company figures mixed together), ask the user which one to use before going on (one question).

workflow.summary: 列出你的数据里有哪些表、哪些报告期、哪些科目，缺了什么；期数够不够回测和预测
workflow.why: 缺的照实列出，能做的照做（你答的第 12 条）

Never type, copy or work out a number yourself: every number you hand back is either a table cell with its address, or the result of compute with its compute id (ids are not consecutive; that is normal). If the scope artifact says in_data is false, do no work in this step: return the structure with empty lists and note 'no data for this company'. Describe, do not judge: no rating, target price, or advice to buy, sell or hold. The steps name line items in standard wording; the user's workbook may word the same item differently (for example 归属于母公司股东的净利润 for 归属于母公司所有者的净利润, 所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 所有者权益合计, 归属于母公司所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 归属于母公司所有者权益合计). Use the row that is the same item and copy its label exactly as read_my_table shows it; a different wording of the same item is not a second basis. Read every sheet of the workbook with read_my_table, all pages. For each sheet list the periods (column labels) and the line items (row labels) exactly as shown. single_quarters is the number of quarterly periods in 利润表 from the earliest to the latest without a gap (each quarterly period gives one single quarter). can_backtest and can_forecast are true when single_quarters is at least 12. missing lists every line item the method needs that the workbook lacks, and every empty cell among those items, with sheet, item, period and why it matters. The method needs: 资产总计, 负债合计, 所有者权益合计, 归属于母公司所有者权益合计 (资产负债表); 营业收入, 营业成本, 净利润, 归属于母公司所有者的净利润, 少数股东损益, 扣除非经常性损益后的归属于母公司股东的净利润 (利润表); 经营活动产生的现金流量净额, 现金及现金等价物净增加额, 期初现金及现金等价物余额, 期末现金及现金等价物余额 (现金流量表); the five rows of 主要会计数据. The user may word a label slightly differently (股东 for 所有者, for example): match by meaning and record the label as written. Do not compute anything.

workflow.title: 勾稽
workflow.summary: 查四条会计恒等式，差额超过 1 元算不平；不平的照实列出，那几期不进预测
workflow.why: 数先对得上，后面的指标和预测才站得住（你答的第 3 条）
workflow.method_text: Pass the task id given in the step instructions on every tool call. Use only the user's own data through list_my_data, read_my_data and read_my_table: no web, no memory, no other source. A cell address is <dataset_id>:<sheet>!<row label>@<column label>, with the labels copied exactly as read_my_table shows them (a repeated label carries #2). Never type, copy or work out a number yourself: every number you hand back is either a table cell with its address, or the result of compute with its compute id (ids are not consecutive; that is normal). If the scope artifact says in_data is false, do no work in this step: return the structure with empty lists and note 'no data for this company'. Describe, do not judge: no rating, target price, or advice to buy, sell or hold. The steps name line items in standard wording; the user's workbook may word the same item differently (for example 归属于母公司股东的净利润 for 归属于母公司所有者的净利润, 所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 所有者权益合计, 归属于母公司所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 归属于母公司所有者权益合计). Use the row that is the same item and copy its label exactly as read_my_table shows it; a different wording of the same item is not a second basis. Run four checks with compute, round 2. (1) For every period of 资产负债表: names a (资产总计), l (负债合计), e (所有者权益合计), expression `a - (l + e)`; put each into bs_check. (2) For every period of 利润表: p (归属于母公司所有者的净利润), m (少数股东损益), n (净利润), expression `p + m - n`; into np_check. (3) For every period of 现金流量表: e (期末现金及现金等价物余额), b (期初现金及现金等价物余额), d (现金及现金等价物净增加额), expression `e - (b + d)`; into cash_check. (4) For every year-end column (YYYY-12-31) of 现金流量表 except the first: o (this year's 期初现金及现金等价物余额), c (the previous year-end's 期末现金及现金等价物余额), expression `o - c`; into opening_check, period = this year-end. Each entry is {period, compute_id, value, balanced} where balanced is true when the difference is at most 1 in absolute value (the unit is yuan). unbalanced lists every check that is not balanced with its name, period and difference; excluded_periods lists those periods, which stay out of the forecast window. A check that cannot run because a cell is empty goes into skipped with the reason; never fill a gap.

workflow.title: 取数
workflow.summary: 把累计数换成单季：Q2 = 半年 − Q1，Q3 = 三季 − 半年，Q4 = 年报 − 三季；资产负债表不换
workflow.why: 预测按单季做，单季的数要能一个个核回你的表（你答的第 4 条）
workflow.method_text: Pass the task id given in the step instructions on every tool call. Use only the user's own data through list_my_data, read_my_data and read_my_table: no web, no memory, no other source. A cell address is <dataset_id>:<sheet>!<row label>@<column label>, with the labels copied exactly as read_my_table shows them (a repeated label carries #2). Never type, copy or work out a number yourself: every number you hand back is either a table cell with its address, or the result of compute with its compute id (ids are not consecutive; that is normal). If the scope artifact says in_data is false, do no work in this step: return the structure with empty lists and note 'no data for this company'. Describe, do not judge: no rating, target price, or advice to buy, sell or hold. The steps name line items in standard wording; the user's workbook may word the same item differently (for example 归属于母公司股东的净利润 for 归属于母公司所有者的净利润, 所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 所有者权益合计, 归属于母公司所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 归属于母公司所有者权益合计). Use the row that is the same item and copy its label exactly as read_my_table shows it; a different wording of the same item is not a second basis. Build single quarters for 营业收入 and 归属于母公司所有者的净利润, and for every item in scope.extra_flow_items, over every quarterly period of 利润表 (现金流量表 for cash-flow items). Q1 (period ending 03-31) is the cumulative cell itself: put it into q1 as {item, period, address, value}. Q2, Q3 and Q4: compute with names cum (this period's cumulative cell) and prev (the previous period's cumulative cell of the same year), expression `cum - prev`, round 2; put it into derived as {item, period, compute_id, value}. 资产负债表 holds point figures: do not convert it.

workflow.title: 算指标与分析
workflow.summary: 算核心指标：毛利率、净利率、净资产收益率、经营现金流与净利润之比、收入与利润增速；分母不成立的标不适用
workflow.why: 口径照你定的写死，分母不成立不硬算（你答的第 5、6 条）
workflow.method_text: Pass the task id given in the step instructions on every tool call. Use only the user's own data through list_my_data, read_my_data and read_my_table: no web, no memory, no other source. A cell address is <dataset_id>:<sheet>!<row label>@<column label>, with the labels copied exactly as read_my_table shows them (a repeated label carries #2). Never type, copy or work out a number yourself: every number you hand back is either a table cell with its address, or the result of compute with its compute id (ids are not consecutive; that is normal). If the scope artifact says in_data is false, do no work in this step: return the structure with empty lists and note 'no data for this company'. Describe, do not judge: no rating, target price, or advice to buy, sell or hold. The steps name line items in standard wording; the user's workbook may word the same item differently (for example 归属于母公司股东的净利润 for 归属于母公司所有者的净利润, 所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 所有者权益合计, 归属于母公司所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 归属于母公司所有者权益合计). Use the row that is the same item and copy its label exactly as read_my_table shows it; a different wording of the same item is not a second basis. For every year-end column (YYYY-12-31), using the full-year cells, compute round 4: gross_margin `(rev - cost) / rev` (营业收入, 营业成本); net_margin `np / rev` (np = 归属于母公司所有者的净利润); roe `np / ((open + close) / 2)` with open = the previous year-end 归属于母公司所有者权益合计 and close = this year-end's (the first year has no opening value: not applicable); cash_ratio `ocf / np` (ocf = 经营活动产生的现金流量净额); revenue_growth `(cur - prev) / prev` on 营业收入 against the previous full year; profit_growth the same on 归属于母公司所有者的净利润. Each entry is {period, compute_id, value}. When a denominator is zero, negative or missing, do not compute: put {indicator, period, reason} into not_applicable. For the line items the question names (scope.items), list their year-end cells in values as {item, period, address, value}. Anything the question asks that cannot be derived from the user's data goes into not_available as {item, reason}. findings describe the trends in plain Chinese sentences, each naming the figures it rests on; describe only, never call a figure good or bad.

workflow.title: 对照官方披露
workflow.summary: 拿第 5 步的分析结论对照年报的管理层讨论：每条判支持或不支持，没提到算不支持，判支持的引原文；找不到这一节照实说
workflow.why: 我们算出来的和管理层在年报里自己说的对一对，引文平台回原件核（你写的补充）
workflow.method_text: Pass the task id given in the step instructions on every tool call. Use only the user's own data through list_my_data, read_my_data and read_my_table: no web, no memory, no other source. A cell address is <dataset_id>:<sheet>!<row label>@<column label>, with the labels copied exactly as read_my_table shows them (a repeated label carries #2). Never type, copy or work out a number yourself: every number you hand back is either a table cell with its address, or the result of compute with its compute id (ids are not consecutive; that is normal). If the scope artifact says in_data is false, do no work in this step: return the structure with empty lists and note 'no data for this company'. Describe, do not judge: no rating, target price, or advice to buy, sell or hold. The steps name line items in standard wording; the user's workbook may word the same item differently (for example 归属于母公司股东的净利润 for 归属于母公司所有者的净利润, 所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 所有者权益合计, 归属于母公司所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 归属于母公司所有者权益合计). Use the row that is the same item and copy its label exactly as read_my_table shows it; a different wording of the same item is not a second basis. The conclusions to check are the sentences in indicators.findings. Check each against what the company's management wrote in the annual reports, reading only the management discussion section. For every annual report PDF in scope.reports: read it with read_my_data from its first page, find in the table of contents the section titled 管理层讨论与分析 (older reports may call it 经营情况讨论与分析 or 董事会报告: find it by its title, never by its section number), read on through that section and stop once it ends; do not read the rest of the report. A page number here is always the N of the '## Page N' line in the text (the PDF page), not the number printed on the page. Put {year, dataset_id, title, first_page, last_page} into sections. If a report has no section under any of these titles, put {year, dataset_id, why} into sections_missing, the why saying plainly 没找到管理层讨论这一节; never treat a missing section as one that mentions nothing. Then put one entry per finding into checks: {finding, verdict, quotes, why}. finding is the sentence copied exactly. verdict is exactly 支持 or exactly 不支持, nothing else: 支持 when the management discussion says the same thing; 不支持 when it says otherwise or does not mention it (not mentioned counts as 不支持). quotes is a list of {dataset_id, page, text}: text copied word for word from that page of that PDF, 10 to 1000 characters, from a narrative paragraph rather than a table; a 支持 needs at least one quote. why says in one sentence how the quote bears on the finding, or that the discussion says otherwise or does not mention it. The platform looks up every quote on its page of its PDF; a quote that is not there fails the step. A 不支持 is a result for the user, not a failure: do not stretch a passage to reach 支持. Finally, for the test, restate the annual reports' revenue as the user copied it: for every year read the 营业收入 row of the sheet 主要会计数据 with read_my_table, list each cell in official_values as {item, year, address, value}, and put {"<year>": {"revenue": "<the cell value>"}} into official_by_year.

workflow.title: 预测
workflow.summary: 季节性同比：下一季 = 上年同季 ×（1 + 近 4 季同比中位数），区间用近 8 季同比的最小、最大；先回测最近 4 季
workflow.why: 方法、回测、区间、假设都写明，不是承诺（你答的第 8、9 条）
workflow.method_text: Pass the task id given in the step instructions on every tool call. Use only the user's own data through list_my_data, read_my_data and read_my_table: no web, no memory, no other source. A cell address is <dataset_id>:<sheet>!<row label>@<column label>, with the labels copied exactly as read_my_table shows them (a repeated label carries #2). Never type, copy or work out a number yourself: every number you hand back is either a table cell with its address, or the result of compute with its compute id (ids are not consecutive; that is normal). If the scope artifact says in_data is false, do no work in this step: return the structure with empty lists and note 'no data for this company'. Describe, do not judge: no rating, target price, or advice to buy, sell or hold. The steps name line items in standard wording; the user's workbook may word the same item differently (for example 归属于母公司股东的净利润 for 归属于母公司所有者的净利润, 所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 所有者权益合计, 归属于母公司所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 归属于母公司所有者权益合计). Use the row that is the same item and copy its label exactly as read_my_table shows it; a different wording of the same item is not a second basis. Forecast 营业收入 and 归属于母公司所有者的净利润, plus every item in scope.extra_flow_items. Build each single-quarter series from series.q1 (use the address) and series.derived (use the compute id), oldest to newest, leaving out reconcile.excluded_periods. All inputs are addresses or compute ids, never numbers. (a) yoy: for every quarter that has the same quarter a year before, compute `(cur - prev) / prev`, round 6, as {item, period, compute_id, value}. (b) If inventory.can_forecast is false or scope.forecast_quarters is 0, forecast nothing and say why in note. Otherwise compute the rates: `median(g)` over the latest 4 yoy ids, `min(g)` and `max(g)` over the latest 8, as {item, kind (median, min or max), for_period ('next'), compute_id, value}. For each forecast quarter h = 1 … scope.forecast_quarters: base = the single quarter of the same quarter one year before; compute `base * (1 + g)` three times, with g the median (point), the min (low) and the max (high), round 2, as {item, period, kind (point, low or high), compute_id, value}. horizon is the number of quarters forecast. (c) Backtest only when inventory.can_backtest is true: for each of the latest 4 actual quarters t, compute the median of the 4 yoy before t and the min and max of the 8 yoy before t (rates with for_period t), then `base * (1 + g)` for point, low and high with base = the same quarter one year before t (backtest entries {item, period, kind, compute_id, value}), then the error `abs(pred - actual) / actual` with pred the point and actual the quarter's own value, round 6 (errors {item, period, compute_id, value, in_range}, in_range true when actual lies between low and high), then `avg(e)` over the 4 errors per item (mean_errors {item, compute_id, value}). Without 12 single quarters there is no backtest: say why in note. (d) Ratios are not extrapolated on their own. assumptions: at least two, including that recent growth continues and that there is no major change of basis or business.

workflow.title: 成稿
workflow.summary: 写成一篇能逐条核对的稿子：回答、带出处的数据、勾稽与对照、指标与发现、预测表、局限、出处；结论留给你
workflow.why: 每个数都有出处，对不上、算不出来的照实写（你答的第 10 条）
workflow.output_file: 底稿/财务分析与预测-成稿.md
workflow.method_text: Pass the task id given in the step instructions on every tool call. Use only the user's own data through list_my_data, read_my_data and read_my_table: no web, no memory, no other source. A cell address is <dataset_id>:<sheet>!<row label>@<column label>, with the labels copied exactly as read_my_table shows them (a repeated label carries #2). Never type, copy or work out a number yourself: every number you hand back is either a table cell with its address, or the result of compute with its compute id (ids are not consecutive; that is normal). If the scope artifact says in_data is false, do no work in this step: return the structure with empty lists and note 'no data for this company'. Describe, do not judge: no rating, target price, or advice to buy, sell or hold. The steps name line items in standard wording; the user's workbook may word the same item differently (for example 归属于母公司股东的净利润 for 归属于母公司所有者的净利润, 所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 所有者权益合计, 归属于母公司所有者权益（或股东权益）合计 for 归属于母公司所有者权益合计). Use the row that is the same item and copy its label exactly as read_my_table shows it; a different wording of the same item is not a second basis. Write the deliverable in Chinese from the input artifacts only; do not call any data tool (writing the file is the only tool use). If scope.in_data is false, the answer says plainly that the user's data has no data for that company （你的数据里没有这家公司）and nothing else is analysed. Whenever something cannot be derived from the user's data, write 算不出来 and why. The file has these sections in order: 回答 (the answer in plain words: the trends and, when a forecast was asked, the point and the range of each forecast quarter with the method in one sentence); 数据 (every number as a table with its source: file, sheet, row, period); 勾稽与对照 (the four checks; then every finding with its verdict 支持 or 不支持, its quotes with the report year and PDF page, and its why, under the line 引文平台核过在原件里；判断是模型做的; a report whose management discussion section was not found is said so plainly); 指标与发现 (describe only); 预测 (method, window, backtest with errors and how many actuals fell in the range, the ranges, the assumptions; a forecast is an extrapolation, never a promise or a target); 局限 (everything in inventory.missing, reconcile.unbalanced and skipped, official.sections_missing, indicators.not_applicable and not_available, and any reason there was no backtest or forecast); 出处 (one line per file: title, dataset id, version; when scope.in_data is false, the files you looked at); 结论 (left blank for the user). Do not paste raw JSON into the file. Never write 目标价, 评级 or phrases like 建议买入 anywhere, not even in a negative sentence such as 不提供目标价: the platform's check rejects the file wherever they appear. The JSON reply carries answer, limitations, citations, data_version and an empty conclusion.
